{{Quote|Made from a genuine Bakuran recipe, this pie features creamy namana custard topped with atomically aerated cream.|Dex's Diner menu, on its namana cream pie|<ref name="Menu" />}}
'''Namana custard''' was a type of [[Custard/Legends|custard]]<ref name="Menu" /> that shared its name with the [[namana]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of tall [[Tree/Legends|tree]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura]].<ref name="Truce at Bakura">''[[The Truce at Bakura]]''</ref> At some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] served a [[namana cream pie]] made with namana custard using a genuine [[Bakuran]] recipe.<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
Namana custard was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
